173.news_title: Taito Vewlix and Xtreme Cabinet Color Plastics Are Available to Purchase in 10 Different Colors
173.long_description: Changing your Taito Vewlix and Arcooda Game Wizard Xtreme cabinet plastics is easy with the reproductions available at Arcooda. Choose from 10 different colors, with mounting accessories and metal brackets also available. Scratched plastics, faded colours, and worn edges can make even a perfectly functioning machine look tired. You might also want to update the cabinet and control panel artwork on your Taito Vewlix machine, so matching this with a new cabinet plastic set will make the cabinet look new again. The Taito Vewlix and Xtreme cabinet plastic sets are available in Black, Blue, Green, Grey, Orange, Pink, Purple, Red, White and Yellow. Custom colors are also available for bulk orders. The cabinet plastic kit consists of seven (7) key plastic pieces that cover the main exterior sections of the cabinet: - Top marquee frame - Monitor surround panels - Side trim pieces - Control panel plastics Installation is generally straight forward if you’re familiar with basic cabinet maintenance. It involves removing the old plastic panels and fitting the new ones into place using existing mounting points. No major modifications are typically required, however, Chewlix machines are all built slightly differently - please check with our team prior to ordering to make sure everything is compatible. Basic Vewlix cabinet plastic colors are in stock and available for immediate shipment.
